correctness.rationale: Exact symmetric similarity by K^(1/2) shows all h>0 spectral/K-energy stability iff K <= 2H; the limit h -> infinity proves necessity. Independent W_h^(1/2) similarity and monotonicity of (1-exp(-h lambda))/lambda prove the Euclidean upper bound. Extreme-eigenspace swaps attain its supremum in the admissible limiting family; a nonparallel oblique rank-one step and SPD perturbation prove Euclidean expansion for each fixed h when H is nonscalar. Fractions-based witness and additional diagnostics verified by included code; finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.
